interpretation: Current Windows mode advertises XUSB10 FF/5D/01 and uses xusb22. Candidate ESP driver must support the Xbox 360 USB/XUSB interface; the Windows HID child is not evidence of a USB HID class 03 interface on the receiver.
limitations: PnP compatible IDs are Windows observations, not a raw USB configuration descriptor dump.
VID/PID alone do not prove complete report, initialization or disconnect behavior.
XInput state is translated by Windows, not a raw USB packet fixture.
Snapshot is not a neutral calibration: right trigger value was 136 at read time.
Packet number is not a sensor capture time or proof of RF freshness.
No rumble, controller reconfiguration, driver replacement or FC commands were performed.
